summary.zh: update/migrate 预览里所有步骤都不可用或失败时，不再提示“确认后追加 --apply 执行”，改为说明没有可执行步骤；部分可执行时说明 --apply 只执行其余步骤。
summary.en: When every step in an update/migrate preview is unavailable or failed, the preview no longer says to add --apply; it explains that nothing is runnable, and for partial previews states that --apply runs only the remaining steps.
